json.notes: A near-circular white panelled arena shell, drawn as a prism following the footprint outline, with a curved all-glass front cut into its south face on the plaza. A broad white roof lip cantilevers over the glass to about 38 m, with a dark underside, and a flat canopy projects over the plaza entrance. The plan's cylinder and roof names are not valid parts, so I built them from prism, box and curtain-glass parts that keep the same positions and sizes.

final.notes: A near-circular white panelled arena shell, drawn as a prism following the footprint outline, with a curved all-glass front cut into its south face on the plaza. A broad white roof lip cantilevers over the glass to about 38 m, with a dark underside, and a flat canopy projects over the plaza entrance. The plan's cylinder and roof names are not valid parts, so I built them from prism, box and curtain-glass parts that keep the same positions and sizes.

photos: photo 1: the front from the street corner, showing the curved glazed facade with CHASE CENTER lettering, the white oval shell rising behind it, and the layered roof edge sweeping out over the front.
photo 2: an elevated aerial of the near-circular white arena, with a flat oval roof bearing the lettering and a glass-walled entrance block on its south-east side, with the city behind.
photo 3: a low three-quarter view from the tram stop, showing the white shell, the overhanging roof lip, and a broad curved canopy sweeping over the entrance above the glass.
